messages:
alex: Quick thread — after yesterday's ws-proxy keepalive canary (zone B), we're seeing short-lived streams that reconnect ~1-3s later and the console shows duplicate token billing. UI shows sessions in "stalled" state for ~20-40s before final close. Anyone triaging?

ops-bot: deploy canary alex/keepalive-ttl rolled at 2026-03-20T21:03:00Z to 10% nodes. :rocket:

maria: saw same on prod metrics — surge in `stream_reconnect` samples at 21:05, sampling rate unchanged. Billing spikes line up with the surge.

tyler: logs from proxy show many short 1006 closes: "session closed before handshake complete", also "resume header missing" for reconnects. Adding snippets to the ticket.

alex: here's a tiny repro header that seems to trigger it:
```http
GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
X-Resume-Id: abc123
```

sam: could be idempotency/resume semantics — if resume id is not persisted across proxy pool swap we may create a new session and double-bill. :thinking_face:

zhen: console UX shows "paused" state that isn't terminal. That might be a front-end interpretation of server-sent heartbeat gap. We should avoid surfacing non-terminal states as billable.

maria: telemetry shows proxy keepalive TTL reduced from 30s -> 5s in canary, which caused early close, client retries immediately, and the ingress billed both partial and resumed tokens.

tyler: proposed fixes: 1) sticky routing for resume id (short-term), 2) longer keepalive TTL, 3) add reconnect-idempotency header so billing can dedupe.

alex: 3 is safest long-term. Could we add a reconciler in billing that ignores token bursts with same reconnect id within Xs?

sam: billing team: dedupe window OK but need reliable reconnect id. If clients sometimes generate new uuid per attempt we're toast.

zhen: UX fix: console should mark "transient reconnect" with a link to logs, not final. Reduce panic.

maria: also sampling/reporting — we currently sample heartbeat telemetry at 1%. For this, increase to 100% for 5m on affected shard to trace.

alex: quick patch: roll canary back to old TTL and enable `X-Reconnect-Id` header logging at proxy to S3 for 1hr. WDYT?

tyler: +1 rollback now, plus add header logging. I'll open a small PR for proxy flag.

sam: I'll draft billing PR for dedupe logic (window 10s) and add tests.

alex: thanks. Assigning follow-ups: tyler -> proxy rollback & header logging; sam -> billing dedupe; zhen -> console UX patch (hide stalled as final); maria -> telemetry sampling bump. Will reconvene in #eng-platform in 15.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-89 (streaming-reconnect-billing-spike). Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-89 :link:
